online.question: How are the online lessons run?
online.answer: The lesson is a video call with a digital board and the platform tools. You need a stable connection, a camera and a microphone — we set the rest up together in the first session.

missed.question: What happens if a lesson is missed?
missed.answer: With advance notice the lesson is postponed. A lesson missed without notice is lost, but the materials, recording and assignments stay on the platform.

parent.question: How does a parent follow the pupil’s progress?
parent.answer: The parent receives a monthly report and can see attendance, assignments and test results in a private LMS cabinet.

switch.question: Can we move from a group to one-to-one lessons?
switch.answer: Yes. Depending on the level and the goal we can move from a group to one-to-one, or the other way around, if a place is available.

age-in-years.prompt: {name} is ${a}$ years old. How old will {name} be in ${b}$ years?

age-years-ago.prompt: {name} was ${a}$ years old ${b}$ years ago. How old is {name} now?

number-plus-equals.prompt: A number plus ${a}$ equals ${b}$. Find the number.

number-twice-plus.prompt: Twice a number plus ${a}$ equals ${b}$. Find the number.

consecutive-sum.prompt: The sum of two consecutive integers is ${s}$. Find the integers.

rectangle-perimeter.prompt: A rectangle has length ${l}$ and width ${w}$. Find the perimeter.

items-total-cost.prompt: ${n}$ items cost ${p}$ lari each. What is the total cost?

distance-speed-time.prompt: Speed is ${v}$ km/h and time is ${t}$ hours. Find the distance.

split-money.prompt: {name} has ${total}$ lari and splits it equally with {name2}. How much does each get?

pages-left.prompt: A book has ${total}$ pages. {name} has read ${read}$. How many are left?

more-than-sum.prompt: {name} has ${a}$ more than {name2}. Together they have ${s}$. How many does {name2} have?

half-of-plus.prompt: Half a number plus ${a}$ equals ${b}$. Find the number.

age-twice-sum.prompt: {name} is twice as old as {name2}. The sum of their ages is ${s}$. How old is {name2}?

sum-and-difference.prompt: The sum of two numbers is ${s}$ and their difference is ${d}$. Find the numbers.

coins-two-kinds.prompt: {name} has ${n}$ coins of ${a}$ lari and ${b}$ lari. The total is ${total}$ lari. How many ${a}-lari coins are there?

consecutive-even.prompt: The sum of three consecutive even integers is ${s}$. Find the integers.

rectangle-area.prompt: A rectangle’s length is ${a}$ more than its width. The area is ${area}$. Find the width.

tickets-two-prices.prompt: Adult tickets cost ${adult}$ lari and child tickets ${child}$ lari. ${n}$ tickets were sold for ${total}$ lari. How many adult tickets were sold?

two-trains.prompt: Two trains approach each other at ${v1}$ km/h and ${v2}$ km/h. They are ${dist}$ km apart. When do they meet?

work-remaining.prompt: {name} finishes a job in ${a}$ hours and has already worked ${b}$ hours. What fraction remains?

mixture-ratio-parts.prompt: A mixture is in the ratio ${a} : {b}$ and totals ${total}$ litres. How much is the first part?

percent-find-whole.prompt: ${p}\%$ of a number is ${part}$. Find the number.

mean-of-two.prompt: {name} scored ${a}$. The mean of that score and another is ${m}$. Find the other score.

two-ages-now.prompt: {name} is ${a}$ years older than {name2}. In ${b}$ years, {name} will be three times {name2}’s age. How old is {name2} now?

two-digit-value.prompt: A two-digit number has tens digit ${a}$ and units digit ${b}$. What is the number?

work-together.prompt: {name} finishes a job in ${a}$ hours, {name2} in ${b}$ hours. How many hours do they need together?

mixture-percent.prompt: ${n1}$ litres of a ${p1}$\%$ solution are mixed with ${n2}$ litres of ${p2}$\%$. What is the mixture’s percent?

boat-current.prompt: A boat’s speed in still water is ${b}$ km/h and the current is ${c}$ km/h. What is the upstream speed?

two-goods-prices.prompt: ${n1}$ pencils and ${n2}$ notebooks cost ${t1}$ lari. ${m1}$ pencils and ${m2}$ notebooks cost ${t2}$ lari. Find the price of one pencil.

age-past-twice.prompt: ${a}$ years ago {name} was twice as old as {name2}. Now {name} is ${b}$ years older. How old is {name2} now?

simple-interest.prompt: ${p}$ lari at ${r}\%$ per year for ${t}$ years. Find the simple interest.

round-trip.prompt: Going at ${v1}$ km/h and returning at ${v2}$ km/h, one way is ${d}$ km. Find the total time.

fraction-word.prompt: $\dfrac{{a}}{{b}}$ of a number is ${part}$. Find the number.

three-consecutive.prompt: Three consecutive integers multiply to ${p}$. The middle one is ${m}$. Write the integers.

reverse-digits.prompt: A two-digit number is ${n}$ more than its reverse. The tens digit is ${a}$ more than the units digit. Find the number.

pipes-fill-empty.prompt: One pipe fills a tank in ${a}$ hours, another empties it in ${b}$ hours. How long to fill an empty tank with both open?

quadrant.prompt: In which quadrant is the point ${point}$?

horizontal-line.prompt: Write the equation of the horizontal line through ${point}$.

vertical-line.prompt: Write the equation of the vertical line through ${point}$.

slope-origin.prompt: Find the slope of the line through $O(0, 0)$ and ${point}$.

point-on-line.prompt: The line ${eq}$ passes through $({x}, y)$. Find $y$.

slope-horizontal.prompt: Find the slope of the line through ${p1}$ and ${p2}$.

slope-rise-run.prompt: On a line, $\Delta x = {run}$ and $\Delta y = {rise}$. Find the slope.

slope-two-points.prompt: Find the slope of the line through ${p1}$ and ${p2}$.

midpoint.prompt: Find the midpoint of the segment with endpoints ${p1}$ and ${p2}$.

write-slope-intercept.prompt: Write the equation of the line with slope ${m}$ and $y$-intercept ${b}$.

point-slope.prompt: A line passes through ${point}$ with slope ${m}$. Write its equation as $y = mx + b$.

parallel-line.prompt: Find the equation of the line parallel to ${eq1}$ that passes through ${point}$.

two-points-equation.prompt: Write the equation of the line through ${p1}$ and ${p2}$.

parabola-shift.prompt: Find the vertex of the parabola ${eq}$.

perpendicular-line.prompt: Find the equation of the line perpendicular to ${eq1}$ that passes through ${point}$.

vertex-form.prompt: Find the vertex of the parabola ${eq}$.

complete-square.prompt: Find the vertex of the parabola ${eq}$.

axis-symmetry.prompt: Find the axis of symmetry of ${eq}$.

circle-center.prompt: Find the centre and radius of the circle ${eq}$.

line-parabola.prompt: Find the intersection points of ${eq1}$ and ${eq2}$.

intercept-count.prompt: How many times does the graph of ${eq}$ meet the $x$-axis?

variantPanel.title: Similar variants
variantPanel.hint: Same wording, new numbers for this card. Other types already in the family are not reused — the solution is recomputed.

variantPanel.noneVerified: No clean numbers were found. Try again.
variantPanel.needSlots: This card’s numbers are baked into the text. Swapping digits at random would break the answer. Put the numbers in {{slots}} in the family JSON, with a formula or derived steps so the solution can be recomputed.

importFamily.title: Screenshot, photo or handwriting
importFamily.hint: Type a problem, upload a screenshot or handwriting, or load a JSON family. We validate it, then the engine fills new numbers.
importFamily.typeHint: The model turns this into a JSON family (parameters, derived values, LaTeX). Equations, arithmetic, and binomial expansions are supported.
importFamily.photoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Keep the writing large and high-contrast.
importFamily.photoDropHint: Drag an image here, or paste a copied screenshot (Ctrl+V).
importFamily.handwritingHint: Photograph the page from above. Avoid glare.
importFamily.jsonHint: A family file like linear-one-step.json. No AI — the engine reads it directly.
importFamily.jsonPasteHint: Paste a copied family object or a list of cards. Put grade (7–12) and difficulty (easy, medium, hard) on each card. No AI — Zod checks the schema, then the engine samples new numbers.
importFamily.checkCasNoFormula: There is no numeric formula to check. Add a formula field or a derived answer.
importFamily.checkCasMismatch: math.js got {got}; the template answer is {expected}.
importFamily.unsupported: This example cannot be turned into a reusable family. Proofs and long word problems are out of scope. Equations, arithmetic, and binomial expansions are in scope.
importFamily.invalidTemplate: The JSON does not match the problem-family schema.
importFamily.diagnoseJson: This text is not valid JSON (a comma, quote, or trailing comma is wrong).
importFamily.diagnoseName: A param or derived name is invalid. Use letters, digits and underscore; at most 24 characters.
importFamily.diagnoseEnum: topic, difficulty, year or instructionId is not in the allowed list.
importFamily.diagnoseLength: The prompt or a solution step is too long.
importFamily.diagnoseMissing: A required field is missing (prompt, solution, or variants).
importFamily.diagnoseCollide: The same name is used in both params and derived.
importFamily.diagnoseSample: The schema is valid, but sampling failed (a derived value, constraint, or slot).
importFamily.diagnoseEmpty: This family has no variants yet. Add a card to generate problems.
importFamily.diagnoseNoMatch: No variant matches the selected difficulty and year.
importFamily.diagnoseSchema: The family object does not match the engine schema.
importFamily.badImage: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
